message.content: {"hts_code": "8542.90.0000", "reason": "Bare or metallized silicon wafers that have not been processed into functional electronic components are classified under the parts of electronic integrated circuits and microassemblies in heading 8542, with the wafer being an unfinished, non-functional test substrate (8542.90.0000, parts of electronic integrated circuits), though the absence of active electronic function and the test-only use should be verified against CBP rulings on unprocessed wafers, which may alternatively fall under 3818.00.0000 (chemical elements doped for use in electronics) or 8548.00.0000 (waste and scrap of electrical components) depending on the level of processing."}

predicted_reason: Bare or metallized silicon wafers that have not been processed into functional electronic components are classified under the parts of electronic integrated circuits and microassemblies in heading 8542, with the wafer being an unfinished, non-functional test substrate (8542.90.0000, parts of electronic integrated circuits), though the absence of active electronic function and the test-only use should be verified against CBP rulings on unprocessed wafers, which may alternatively fall under 3818.00.0000 (chemical elements doped for use in electronics) or 8548.00.0000 (waste and scrap of electrical components) depending on the level of processing.
